Running out of storage? Cleaner X helps you reclaim space—without uploading your photos to the cloud.

All scans run on your device. Your personal media stays on your iPhone. Always.


SMART CLEAN — ONE TAP

• AI-powered Smart Clean finds duplicates, similar shots, and clutter in one tap
• Best Shot keeps your sharpest photo in every group
• Deep Scan runs 7 parallel scans across your entire library
• Live Activity shows real-time scan progress on your Lock Screen


CLEAN YOUR LIBRARY

• Duplicates & Similar Photos — powered by on-device Vision AI
• Screenshots, Live Photos & Screen Recordings
• Short Videos & Large Files
• Blurry Photos — spot low-quality shots instantly
• Swipe to Clean — swipe left to delete, right to keep


ORGANIZE & OPTIMIZE

• Merge duplicate contacts
• Remove old & duplicate calendar events
• Compress videos to HEVC and save storage
• Convert Live Photos to still images
• Review iCloud-only assets


ENCRYPTED PRIVATE VAULT

• AES-GCM encrypted photo storage
• Unlock with Face ID or PIN
• Recovery Log tracks deletions for 30 days
• Your vault files never leave this device


PRIVACY FIRST

• 100% on-device scanning — no cloud upload
• No personal media sent to our servers
• Revoke permissions anytime in Settings
• Full transparency in Privacy Center


PREMIUM

Upgrade to Premium for:
• Unlimited on-device scans
• Ad-free experience
• Full Vault Pro access
• All organize & compress tools

Download Cleaner X today and take back your storage—privately.
